coverage_note: Batch 1 of run phase-2-remaining-27 (4 pages, 63 items) was read in full: every assigned page and item was opened, together with the published dependencies needed to verify each claim, which were checked at the level of the exact cited clause (and the surrounding proof text where a computation or identity had to be reproduced) rather than re-proved from their own hypotheses. Three confirmed defects in in-flight items were repaired and each changed item was reflowed and prechecked clean (reflow reported 'unchanged'; precheck all PASS): a corrupted clause in lem-trigonometric-characters-are-orthonormal step 2.1, an undefined symbol m_j in thm-fourier-basis-and-parseval-on-the-n-torus step 1.1, and an unproved pointwise non-convergence assertion in the claim section of ex-fourier-series-of-a-square-wave; the affected claims were synchronised in the batch and merged proof contracts, and no changed item carried a verification.judge record. No defect was found in a published dependency, so no uneditable finding remains. Residual limitation: I read the cited clause (plus the proof text where a computation was used) of the roughly one hundred published dependencies rather than re-proving all of them from their own hypotheses, and I verified each citation quote against the library's on-disk transcript of its source rather than against the books' own pagination, so the page/lecture locators in sources.references were not independently re-verified; I also did not adjudicate the necessity (as opposed to the use) of the declared choice principles. No blocker; no item, page or claim was deleted or withdrawn.
